name: uneXpected Excel VBA Toolkit

source.reuseApproach: Reviewed and independently rewritten utilities based on selected upstream patterns; see module-level source notes and LICENSE.

compatibility.vba: VBA 7 compatible; no external VBA project references required beyond the standard Excel/Office object model
notes: File-system enumeration uses late-bound Scripting.FileSystemObject and is intended for Windows desktop Excel.
The data-validation module uses a late-bound Scripting.Dictionary for duplicate detection.
The toolkit is importable source code; it does not run inside the Node.js/Render service.
Excel desktop compilation and runtime behavior must be verified in a real supported Office installation before production use.

useCases: General data cleanup and quality checks

modules.name: modUxWorkbook
modules.purpose: Explicit-workbook worksheet checks and robust last-used row/column lookup.

modules.name: modUxFileSystem
modules.purpose: Read-only file/folder checks, file inventory, and user-driven file/folder selection.

modules.name: modUxText
modules.purpose: Case-insensitive keyword matching against an explicitly supplied Excel range.

modules.name: modUxDataValidation
modules.purpose: Read-only header lookup, required-header checks, blank counts, and duplicate-cell identification.

modules.name: modUxApplicationState
modules.purpose: Capture, apply, and restore selected Excel application settings around bulk work.

modules.name: modUxDiagnostics
modules.purpose: Append sanitized error records to a caller-selected existing folder.

excludedUpstreamRoutines.reason: Attempts to bypass workbook or worksheet protection; excluded.
Can permanently sever workbook links; not included as an automatic utility.
Changes message read state and can overwrite same-named files; excluded pending a separately designed, consent-based workflow.
Mutates broad application and workbook settings, including link-update behavior; replaced with a narrow state-preserving helper.

designRules: Industry-neutral core; add domain-specific packs separately and only when requested.
Inspect the actual workbook schema before writing workbook-specific automation.
Prefer macro-free formulas, tables, and Power Query when they meet the requirement.

verification.automated: Node.js static source and safety-contract tests
requiredBeforeProduction: Import all .bas files into a disposable macro-enabled workbook.
Compile the VBA project with Option Explicit enabled.
Exercise workbook lookup, file enumeration, cancellation, empty ranges, duplicate detection, permissions, and application-state restoration in supported Excel desktop versions.
Validate results against representative sample workbooks from each intended use case before production rollout.
